children: US real estate developer's Q3 revenue rose 34% yr/yr to $17.9 mln
Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled, up 112% yr/yr to $2.3 mln
Net income rose 9% to $0.6 mln, impacted by $1.0 mln unrealized loss on equity investments
Company expects to deliver record results in 2026
Comstock says it is positioned for sustained growth and long-term value creation
Company sees opportunities to expand platform beyond Washington, D.C. region
PORTFOLIO EXPANSION - Co said growth in managed portfolio and new contracts drove increases in recurring fee-based and asset management revenue
SUBSIDIARY GROWTH - ParkX subsidiary posted 65% revenue growth in Q3, contributing to overall results
INVESTMENT LOSSES - Q3 net income was reduced by a $1.0 mln unrealized loss on Jericho equity investments
